cases.explanation: A removed empty cell can expose a column fill. Selection resolves the cell, row and column styles in both packages before deciding which region requires capture.
cases.boundary: Style indices are package-local. Equal values or different indices alone do not establish equal formatting.

cases.title: Every live state controls the split
code: // Split if any live state is too large.
cases.explanation: The planner measures the same candidate in every live state. A hidden range in one workbook can be visible in its partner. Any oversized state forces further partitioning.
cases.boundary: A missing measurement is an error. Zero-area leaves retain an observation. A single oversized cell fails instead of disappearing.
cases.notation: Abbreviated illustration. Omitted helpers and guards remain part of the source contract.

cases.title: Queue, synchronize, then consume
cases.explanation: One synchronization completes the queued Office.js image requests. Returned images are then dimension-checked, cropped without resampling and finalized before another bounded batch.
cases.boundary: The batch pixel limit also applies. A heartbeat while synchronization is pending does not prove that a capture completed.
cases.notation: Abbreviated illustration. Omitted helpers and guards remain part of the source contract.

cases.title: An absent image retains an outcome
cases.explanation: In the synthetic visibility-transition control, only the transformed state exposes a row. The original has a zero-area observation and no invented white image.
cases.boundary: No paired pixels were compared. The rendering and geometry change remains a finding rather than an equality result.
